title: Freeze agent and workflow service ports
objective: Freeze interface-only agent, context, validation, review and delivery ports using shared values; no orchestration contracts or concrete behavior.

acceptance_criteria.description: Define AgentAdapter, ContextBuilder, Validator and ReviewService requests/results
acceptance_criteria.verification: TASK-003 owned behavior tests and structured handoff evidence

acceptance_criteria.description: Define DeliveryAdapter and workflow service composition boundaries with cancellation and ambiguous outcomes
acceptance_criteria.verification: TASK-003 failure-case tests and structured handoff evidence

output_contracts: domain/workflow_ports public behavior described by this task acceptance; use predeclared ports
size_rationale: One component outcome with two bounded acceptance checks; no central registry edits. Split further through isolation review if implementation exceeds this estimate.
out_of_scope: Changing shared contracts without a new prerequisite task
Production provider integration, paid services, remote publication and product-scope changes
handoff_requirements: Exact base/commit and verified changed paths
Actual test command evidence and acceptance mapping
Public interface/dependency notes, deviations and risks
